scope: Local annual history expansion potential and official CLF source-block review; candidate counts are not accepted or certified counts

local_raw_zip_check.definition: Scan original num.txt with roster annual 10-K/20-F filings, qtrs=4 and tag containing PerShare/Pershare, including custom tags, not only the normalized legacy file.
local_raw_zip_check.limitations: These ZIPs are third-party library fixtures; quarterly completeness and byte identity to SEC were not certified.

safe_acceptance_rules: Prefer extending a current coherent filing from its own original selected-financial-data table, after validating the row is total diluted EPS, exact full fiscal-year dates, parent/common-share identity, units and publication cutoff. This can be automated after a source-specific reviewed extraction contract.

Across filings, require an explicit reviewed bridge tied to exact source and target accessions, share class, EPS definition and independently evidenced split events. Matching tag labels, empty split facts, matching EPS or a fitted overlap ratio do not verify comparability.
Deduplicate exact annual periods using the latest eligible reviewed source vintage; retain all raw observations and conflict reasons. Do not pick values by desired model outcome.
Reject unresolved share-class/dimension/coreg ambiguity, same-filing conflicting values, missing dates/units, nonannual duration or future availability. Keep roster gaps rather than zero-fill.
Keep original values, source precision, multipliers and URLs. Multipliers apply once per source block, never indiscriminately to a mixed-vintage assembled series.
USD in these old DERA files is an original unit label for per-share tags, not enough to prove a USD/shares economic basis. Confirm the original financial-statement unit heading.
A deliberate unverified as-reported scenario may preserve unverified records separately, but must not be labeled safe/verified merely because a numerical overlap passes.
Do not overwrite eps0/TTM, price or consensus when extending annual history. Preserve nonpositive annual EPS for the loss-state prior and only use positive-to-positive annual pairs for growth.
Limit to the most recent at most 11 distinct nonoverlapping eligible annual periods; a longer window requires acquisition of pre-2007 original statements for most issuers.
limitations: Local potential excludes any newly downloaded history or source-specific official supplements created after this audit.
The overlap counts use exact period_end and exact numbers only as a diagnostic. They neither accept nor reject an economic bridge by themselves.
Corporate acquisitions, divestitures, accounting changes and dilution can change economic scope even when stock-split units are reconciled.
More history can alter both growth/volatility estimates and loss prior. It does not by itself calibrate forecast probabilities.
